g:Label.text: The scores: the scorers below are the bar a served record must clear — one that falls short sends its shape back to be learned while the rule keeps serving — and the judges of every candidate a session learns. The gate here decides whether what was learned becomes a rule.

form:FormGroup.label: Promotion mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Automatic: a candidate that passes the gate goes live. Review: it is appended as a draft rule the router skips, and the streams of its learner wait until a person approves it.

form:FormGroup.label: Promotion floor (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The weighted score a candidate must reach on the held-out sample before it can be promoted. It must also not regress against the incumbent on any previously accepted record.

form:FormGroup.label: Held-out fraction (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The share of a shape's records withheld from the model and used only to judge promotion.

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum records per shape
form:FormGroup.helpText: Records a shape must have accumulated before promotion is judged; below this a candidate that clears the floor is bound provisionally and waits for more.

form:FormGroup.label: Regression records per rule
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most previously accepted records retained per rule for the regression check.

form:FormGroup.label: Regression retention (days)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long regression records are kept, never longer than the source feed's own retention. Zero follows the feed's.

form:FormGroup.label: Flag a serving rule below (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: A rule whose rolling per-record score falls below this is flagged in the Supervisor's serving list. It goes on serving; a record that falls short of the bar is what sends a shape back to be learned.
